about_the_game:
Zima is a cozy RPG that plunges you into a relentless unnatural winter. As you delve into ancient temples to combat a growing corruption, you’ll unravel the mysterious legacy of who you are and what your purpose is. Prepare to uncover secrets buried deep within the Sacred Temples and uncover your true identity.

In the Zima Demo you'll be able to fully clear the first of 3 hand made underground dungeons and face the first boss, Temple Guardian Chuvar. Slash your sword, shoot your bow, thrust your spear, toss your boomerang, and cast your staff to destroy the corruption! When you're tired of combat, spend some time gathering logs for the furnace or upgrading your home.

In Zima you play as a fierce and stubborn young woman determined to protect her home, and the secrets that lie beneath... Within the Sacred Temples you will fight your way through corrupted enemies and forgotten temple guardians using action combat and skill based dodging all while avoiding traps meant to keep intruders out! 

  • Your arsenal will include both melee and ranged weapons that can be upgraded using currency gathered within the temples.

  • Each temple contains hidden rooms with materials essential for upgrading items in your home, so be sure to explore thoroughly!

  • Upgrade choices provide unique buffs, allowing customization of your survival strategy.

  • Most importantly, The Eternal Flame is your lifeline — you'll need to gather Living Coal found within the temples to maintain it and should you fail... winter will slowly consume you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 460 / Radeon HD 5850

short_description: A cozy pixel art RPG in a winter setting about a young woman who discovers her true purpose and combats a growing threat... Protect the Sacred Grotto and ensure that you are not overcome by the relentless cold!
